# BrewReel / 精酿

> BrewReel is an open-source tool with three paths. Promo: you provide a product brief, a language model writes the storyboard, and code renders it locally from a recipe. Talking-head B-roll: you provide one talking-head video, and one command adds motion cards or AI pictures. Lesson videos: 16:9 animated slides with a presenter. Review either result before publishing.

精酿 · BrewReel 是开源工具，有三种玩法。宣传片：你提供产品简报，语言模型编写分镜，程序按配方在本机渲染。口播配画面：只放一段口播视频，一条命令配上动效画面或 AI 画面。讲课视频：16:9 动态幻灯片加讲解员。成片都需要人工检查后再发布。

## Product facts

- Who it is for: Developers and creators comfortable setting up a local runtime. Use it for product introductions, feature explainers, quiz videos or character-journey promos, or to add explanatory pictures to a talking-head video you already have.
- 适合什么需求：面向愿意安装本地运行环境的开发者和内容创作者。可以做产品介绍、卖点讲解、答题互动或角色漫游宣传片，也可以给已有的口播配上解释画面。
- Inputs and outputs: Promo: a product brief, optional real photos and voiceover settings in; a vertical promo and its storyboard out. cards and quiz default to 1080×1920, journey to 1080×1350, all at 30 fps. Talking-head B-roll: one talking-head video in, a video with pictures out. The output directory must sit outside the repo.
- 输入与输出：宣传片：输入产品简报、可选实拍与配音配置，输出竖版宣传片和分镜。cards、quiz 默认 1080×1920，journey 默认 1080×1350，均为 30 fps。口播配画面：输入一段口播视频，输出配了画面的成片。输出目录不能放在仓库里面。
- Costs and requirements: The project uses Apache-2.0. Promo model calls and voiceover APIs may charge separately. For talking-head B-roll, on-device transcription, motion cards and the final cut do not charge; AI pictures use MiniMax, print an estimate first, and need a person's approval before the official cut. Remotion has a separate license; for-profit organizations with four or more employees need a Company License.
- 费用与使用条件：项目采用 Apache-2.0 许可。宣传片的模型调用和配音接口可能另收费。口播配画面里，本机转写、动效画面和合成不花钱；AI 画面用 MiniMax，先估价、人审批准才出正式片。Remotion 有独立许可，4 人及以上的营利组织需购买 Company License。

Project author: Finderchangchang . See the GitHub documentation for installation, test records and known limitations.

## Read before use

- A language model writes the storyboard; rendering is performed locally with code.
- Generated videos are drafts that need human review before publication.
- Model and voiceover API calls may incur separate provider fees.
- The DeepSeek Harness plugin is published, but the project documentation still marks real DeepSeek-model testing as pending.
- MiniMax voiceover has been tested; Alibaba Cloud and Volcengine voiceover still need live-key verification.
- Talking-head B-roll takes one clip and one command. On-device transcription, motion cards and the final cut do not charge. MiniMax AI pictures print an estimate first, and a person approves before the official cut. The DeepSeek Harness plugin does not include this.
- The style factory drafts an AI picture style from one sentence. A person runs approve-style.mjs in a terminal. New styles are welcome back as contributions.

## Practical guides

- [用 BrewReel 做第一支宣传片：先跑样例，再换成自己的产品](https://brewreel.com/guides/first-promo-video.html): 从本地依赖到样例出片，再到产品简报与发布检查。把环境是否可用、模型是否写对和成片是否能发布分开验证。
- [Make your first BrewReel promo video: run a sample, then use your own product](https://brewreel.com/guides/first-promo-video.en.html): Set up the local renderer, validate and render an existing storyboard, then move to a product brief and a human review before publishing.
- [AI 宣传片产品简报怎么写：可下载模板与餐饮示例](https://brewreel.com/guides/product-brief.html): 把卖什么、给谁看、真实卖点、价格条件和素材来源写清楚。提供空白 Markdown 模板和明确标为虚构的餐饮示例。
- [Write a product brief for an AI promo video: template and fictional café example](https://brewreel.com/guides/product-brief.en.html): Specify the audience, product action, supported claims, price conditions and asset sources. Download a blank Markdown brief and a clearly fictional example.
